value.summary: Updated tests/summary.test.mjs: the deepEqual expectation now includes displayName (summary({ name: "ada" }) deep-equals { name: "ada", displayName: "ADA" }), and added a dedicated compatibility test asserting the name field is still present with its original value. Only tests/summary.test.mjs was modified, per the declared write target.

evidenceCandidates.statement: The suite now pins both halves of API-001: displayName upper-cased via deepEqual, and name preserved via the dedicated assertion; the API-001-A node --test acceptance executes both.
